name: FORWARD SPINE STRETCH
introduce: Sit on the floor with your feet hip width apart. Lift your arms at shoulder height, curl your chin towards your chest. \n\nAs you exhale, draw your abdomen in and use your hands to reach your toes. Inhale and come back. Repeat it.

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Exhale as you reach forward, and inhale as you come back.
Pull your toes toward your body.
Bring your shoulders down away from your ears.
